name: blueprint/daily-digest
description: Collect sources, summarize, and send on a schedule — extractive (term-frequency) locally, LLM synthesis (ask-ai) as escalation.
recipe: gather sources → summarize (DSH-native: ctx.llm synthesis; extractive ranks by term frequency as the local stand-in) → notify / store + MDX
cost_hint: paid model + search (ask-ai tier); free (extractive + RSS)
pitfalls: probe selector/markup before parsing (HN dropped titlelink)
extractive surfaces representative items but does NOT synthesize — say so
Reddit: JSON API is IP-blocked (403); use RSS (browser UA, Accept: application/rss+xml, spaced requests + 429/403 backoff)
Reddit RSS: decode entities before stripping tags; cut the 'submitted by … [comments]' boilerplate; filter AutoMod/featured comment-feed repeats
DSH-native form: tool-to-tool via ctx.tools.execute; synthesis via ctx.llm.stream + BlockAssembler; MDX deliverable via ctx.fs with presentCall locations + presentResult diff
local_limits: one-shot only (no schedule — OS cron is the scheduler, not part of the tool); extractive ranks but does NOT synthesize; title-only for most sources (no snippet enrichment)
cloud_limits: ask-ai synthesis + web-search paid per token/query; cron adds cold start + account quotas; full-body enrichment via Browser Run per-fetch + ToS-gray. Measured (cloud): HN Algolia front_page works (10 items) but Google News RSS 503 from CF egress → news half empty; brittle HN HTML selector replaced with Algolia
